name: Tonmoy Das
title: PhD Student · Medical Bioinformatics & Systems Medicine
institution: Institute of Medical Bioinformatics and Systems Medicine, Universitätsklinikum Freiburg
bio: I work at the intersection of medical bioinformatics, spatial transcriptomics, and reproducible R-based analysis workflows. My current focus is turning complex biomedical datasets into interpretable results for cancer biology, with a particular interest in glioblastoma heterogeneity, tumor microenvironments, and transparent research tooling.

projects.name: GBM Spatial Transcriptomics Analysis
projects.description: Archived analysis code for a glioblastoma spatial-transcriptomics project studying 5ALA-positive infiltrative tumor cells, regional subtype plasticity, wound-response signaling, stemness, recurrence, and survival associations.

projects.name: Technical Notes & Reproducible Workflows
projects.description: A living notebook of practical fixes and reusable snippets for R, Python, Conda, Linux, Bash, and Git workflows used while building reproducible computational biology analyses.

experience.org: Institute of Medical Bioinformatics and Systems Medicine, Universitätsklinikum Freiburg
experience.description: Researching medical bioinformatics and systems medicine questions with an emphasis on computational analysis, reproducible data workflows, and interpretation of high-dimensional biomedical datasets.

Built R analysis scripts for heatmaps, pathway enrichment, exon-intron split analysis, stemness scoring, correlation analysis, and survival-focused visualizations for a GBM spatial-transcriptomics study.
